item.title: $2 million awarded to Broome County for water quality protection and environmental initiatives
item.description: New York state awarded Broome County over $2 million to fund several water quality protection and environmental improvement initiatives. item.title: University will not renew partnership with Sodexo, selects new food service provider
item.description: Binghamton University announced it will not renew its food contract with Sodexo on Thursday, opting instead for a new 10-year partnership with Chartwells Higher Education, which operates at more than 330 colleges and universities. The contract is expected to start on June 1, 2026. The announcement comes after a year of student activism around campus...

item.description: Preliminary work began this week as part of a $43.1 million project to reconnect parts of Downtown Binghamton to the riverfront and create more accessible green space.
